Pumpkin seeds, a tin of sardines and a jacket potato with the skin on.

An analysis of the UK's national diet survey found more than 1 in 5 men in their 20s don't get the minimum amount of magnesium they need. Zinc contributes to the maintenance of normal testosterone levels, vitamin D contributes to normal muscle function, and EPA and DHA from oily fish contribute to the normal function of the heart.

Food comes first, and most of this list is already in the supermarket you go to every week.

Save this, and send it to a man who needs a nudge this Movember.

variants.hook: Did you know more than 1 in 5 UK men in their 20s don't get minimum amount of magnesium they need?
